characterList.description: The person speaking in the video. He is only shown from his hands down. He has light skin and short nails.
characterList.name: Narrator

qAndA.question: What is the pre-set combination of the Master Lock shown in the video?

qAndA.answer: At the top of the lock, next to the shackle.
qAndA.question: Where is the small niche located on the lock that is crucial for resetting?

qAndA.answer: Press it down and hold it.
qAndA.question: What should you do with the silver part inside the niche while changing the combination?

qAndA.answer: The shackle should no longer release when you change the numbers from the newly set combination.
qAndA.question: How do you know if you've successfully changed the lock combination?

qAndA.answer: Neutral and instructional. The narrator is calm and focused on providing clear instructions.
qAndA.question: What is the overall mood of the video?

activities.description: Narrator holds up a black Master Lock.
Narrator points to the combination displayed on the lock (621).

characterInteraction.description: The narrator directly addresses the viewer.

narrativeProgression.description: Introduction to the topic and the specific lock used.
The narrator identifies the pre-set combination on the lock.

activities.description: Narrator attempts to close the lock with the combination changed, showing it won't lock.
Narrator resets the combination to 621 and closes the lock.

characterInteraction.description: The narrator continues to address the viewer.

narrativeProgression.description: Demonstrates that changing the combination prevents the lock from closing.
Confirms that the lock only closes with the correct (original) combination.

activities.description: Narrator points to the small niche at the top of the lock.
Narrator presses down the silver part inside the niche.
Narrator changes the lock combination to 732 while pressing down the silver part.
Narrator releases the silver part and demonstrates that the lock is now set to 732.

characterInteraction.description: The narrator maintains direct address to the viewer.

narrativeProgression.description: Identifies the critical point for resetting - the niche and the silver part.
Explains the process of holding down the silver part while setting the new combination.
Demonstrates the success of the process - the lock now operates on the new combination.

scenes.title: Resetting the Lock and Setting a New Combination

climax.description: The narrator successfully changes the lock combination and demonstrates its functionality.

storylines.description: Instructional - The video demonstrates how to set a 3-digit Master Lock.

content_metadata.title: How to Set a 3-Digit Master Lock

trimmingSuggestions.description: The initial portion of Scene 2 where the narrator demonstrates the lock not closing with a changed combination could be shortened.
